info.title: Waystation API
info.description: A set of tools that connect ChatGPT to productivity apps

get.summary: Get a list of user's boards from Monday
get.description: Retrieves a list of boards associated with the authenticated user from Monday.

200.description: A JSON array of user boards

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on the server.

get.summary: Get items from a specific Monday board
get.description: Retrieves all items from the specified Monday board. The items can be arbitrary JSON objects.

parameters.name: boardId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Monday board.

200.description: A JSON array of board items.

items.description: Arbitrary JSON object representing a board item.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid or missing board ID.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on the server.
